Introducing Breakify Working with multi-line text in React can sometimes be confusing. What you type into a textarea isn't always obvious when it becomes a JavaScript string. That's why I built Breakify. Breakify helps developers visualize exactly how line breaks are represented in text. It instantly converts multi-line input into its string format, making hidden characters like \n visible and easy to understand.
